title: Ada and the Archive Revisited
author: Gideon Marchetti
blurb: Odile Whitlock, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
